description: A Perl script for interacting with the Wesnoth campaign server, capable of listing campaigns, querying terms, and downloading campaigns.

methods.name: check_error
methods.description: Checks for error messages in server response and terminates if found.

methods.name: extract_message
methods.description: Extracts message from server response if present.

methods.name: unarchive_dir
methods.description: Recursively unarchives campaign data into specified directory.
